_about: HPN ATC speech-to-text words (GitHub #233; sizeup/atc.py). 'phrases': Amazon Transcribe's custom vocabulary for the airband channels (pushed as sizeup-atc with the PCFD one, Settings > Radios > Vocabulary > Push): written as said on the air, no digits (runway 'one six', not '16'), at most 256 characters each. 'prompt': whisper's prompt for an airband channel when it runs on the station's model; the callsigns of the aircraft nearest HPN (the Aircraft layer) are added after it. Version 2 (#257): HPN's approaches (RNAV (GPS) Yankee, ILS; in the prompt too), its approach fixes (the vocabulary only: in whisper's prompt they came back as words on noise, tools/atc_eval.py) (TWORF, TAYSH ...: FAA CIFP, data/airport/khpn_procedures.geojson) and more telephony; the written forms are sizeup/atc_normalize.py's. From shortfinal's stt_prompt.py (airport_vocabulary, PHRASES) and data/khpn_operators.csv (who actually flies at HPN; telephony from FAA JO 7340.2), with the fire department's words. #369: the abnormal words of a go-around (flaps, landing gear, hydraulics, checklist, divert, 'alert level'). Taxiways: data/airport/khpn_surface.geojson (OpenStreetMap).

Cleared to land, cleared for takeoff, line up and wait, hold short, go around, missed approach, flaps, landing gear, hydraulics, checklist, divert, souls on board, fuel remaining, declaring an emergency, roll the trucks.
